description:
Get policySettings from copilot

TIP: Gets a specific Copilot policy setting by ID. Returns the setting's current value plus its default, dataType, allowed values (for enum-type), description, last update timestamp. Use to drill into a specific policy after list-copilot-policy-settings identified it. Beta-only endpoint.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-copilot-policy-setting
